decisions.reason: As a newly launched add-on tightly linked to the firm's existing web-map offer and already updated repeatedly, it is likely to be kept while management lets early market feedback accumulate.

Although less prominently presented than some other launches, it is close to the core product base, so an established medium-sized GIS firm with some slack would more likely retain it than withdraw it after only a short trial period.
Its home-page visibility and clear mobile-usability value suggest results at least near aspiration for a complementary component, supporting continuation rather than immediate exit.

Because this platform is a flagship product line aligned with the firm's strategic direction and core capabilities, behavioral-theory logic implies very strong persistence unless results are clearly disastrous, for which there is no sign here.

This product fits the firm's established geospatial solution portfolio and was given dedicated presentation, so management would likely continue backing it while assessing demand and learning from deployment experience.

As a focused extension for web map applications with its own page and strong relatedness to existing offerings, it is more likely to be retained as part of the broader solution bundle than dropped quickly.
